headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education, firms are balancing AI investments with cost pressures while revenue trends diverge.
summary: Media giants report solid revenue growth but tighten IT spend amid restructuring. Gaming shows mixed results as digital platforms expand but profit margins vary. Publishing firms are split between AI‑driven product launches and earnings shortfalls. Education players are investing heavily in AI and quantum initiatives, with most reporting positive sentiment.

industries.summary: Disney posted 7% revenue growth and strong operating margin, while WBD/Skydance raised its EBITDA outlook. Versant reaffirmed guidance with modest growth. Cost‑cutting and AI projects dominate the agenda.

leaders.why: Largest revenue ($25,248 m) and strong operating margin

laggards.why: No financial data and neutral sentiment
